- 重新设计文件移动目标页，支持浏览存储设备、空文件夹和树状目录，并隐藏高版本系统中不可操作的 Android 目录
- 增加所有文件访问权限检查，缺少权限时会使用应用内对话框引导前往系统设置
- 对齐 Miuix 原版静态配色，统一顶栏、页面背景、设置卡片和控件的颜色层级
- 加入媒体列表缓存和加载动画，减少每次进入应用时的空白等待
- 修复预测性返回开关失败时仍显示为已启用的问题，并改善部分设备上的悬浮导航栏兼容性

<details>
<summary>English Version</summary>

- Redesign the file move destination screen with storage devices, empty folders, and tree navigation, while hiding the inaccessible Android directory on newer systems
- Add all-files access checks with an in-app dialog that guides users to the system settings when permission is missing
- Align the static color scheme with the original Miuix palette and unify the color hierarchy across top bars, page backgrounds, settings cards, and controls
- Add media list caching and loading animation to reduce blank waiting when entering the app
- Prevent the predictive back setting from appearing enabled when activation fails, and improve floating navigation bar compatibility on some devices
